topic: How does antenna design influence the accuracy of encrypted traffic classification systems in heterogeneous satellite networks?
consensus_response: Antenna design affects signal quality, influencing encrypted traffic classification accuracy. Polarization correlation and operating frequency impact signal characteristics, while complex designs like arrays introduce variability. Beamforming techniques mitigate interference, enhancing signal-to-noise ratio and classification performance.
reference_context: SatCom systems use beamforming and polarization to optimize signal quality, with operating frequencies like 2.2GHz reducing environmental interference.
